name: Jougasaki Mika
source:
Mika is an idol and a fan of the gal subculture. Like any older sister, she and Rika Jougasaki don't always see eye to eye, and squabble on occasion, but most of the time they get along just fine. Mika really cares for her little sister, and serves as a bit of a role-model for her.

[From [url=http://www.project-imas.com/wiki/Mika_Jougasaki]Project IM@S Wiki[/url]]
